tools.name: indirect-tax_eu-oss-threshold-check
tools.description: Decide whether an EU-established supplier's B2C cross-border TBE services and distance sales stay taxed at home or switch to the customer's Member State under the EU-wide €10,000 threshold. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/indirect-tax/eu-oss-threshold-check. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment te

tools.name: indirect-tax_canada-gst-hst-pst
tools.description: Look up GST/HST (and PST where the CRA table lists one) for a province and date, and compute tax on an amount in cents. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/indirect-tax/canada-gst-hst-pst. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: indirect-tax_australia-nz-gst
tools.description: Test AU/NZ GST registration thresholds from monthly turnover and optionally extract GST from an inclusive or exclusive price. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/indirect-tax/australia-nz-gst. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: indirect-tax_uk-vat-flat-rate
tools.description: Return the HMRC Flat Rate Scheme percentage for a business type and date (including limited-cost and first-year discount) and compute VAT due on VAT-inclusive turnover. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/indirect-tax/uk-vat-flat-rate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: indirect-tax_vat-invoice-requirements
tools.description: Check a supplied invoice against HMRC Notice 700/21 full and simplified VAT invoice content rules and recompute arithmetic. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/indirect-tax/vat-invoice-requirements. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: indirect-tax_uk-mtd-itsa-obligations
tools.description: Tell a sole trader or landlord when Making Tax Digital for Income Tax applies from qualifying income, and list quarterly update deadlines. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/indirect-tax/uk-mtd-itsa-obligations. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: indirect-tax_us-use-tax-accrual
tools.description: Compute use tax owed on purchases where the vendor charged less than the caller-supplied combined rate, with per-jurisdiction totals. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/indirect-tax/us-use-tax-accrual. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "indirect-tax" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: indirect-tax_eu-oss-threshold-check, indirect-tax_vat-invoice-requirements, indirect-tax_uk-mtd-itsa-obligations · Public sink: indirect-tax_eu-oss-threshold-check, indirect-tax_canada-gst-hst-pst, indirect-tax_australia-nz-gst, indirect-tax_uk-vat-flat-rate, indirect-tax_vat-invoice-requirements, indirect-tax_uk-mtd-itsa-obligations, indirect-tax_us-use-tax-accrual · Destructive: indirect-tax_eu-oss-threshold-check, indirect-tax_canada-gst-hst-pst, indirect-tax_australia-nz-gst, indirect-tax_uk-vat-flat-rate, indirect-tax_vat-invoice-requirements, indirect-tax_uk-mtd-itsa-obligations, indirect-tax_us-use-tax-accrual.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
